reference_gap: UPDATE club_license_terms SET payment_reference = 'LIC-0005' WHERE payment_reference = 'LIC-0003'

snapshot.name: club_license_terms
snapshot.sql: SELECT c.name AS club, t.payment_reference, t.plan::text AS plan, t.starts_at, t.ends_at, t.activated_by_admin_id, t.activated_at, t.source_command_id, t.pricing_at_activation::text AS pricing_at_activation, t.paid_on::text AS paid_on, t.amount_minor, t.currency, t.notes, t.created_at FROM club_license_terms t JOIN clubs c ON c.id = t.club_id ORDER BY t.payment_reference, t.source_command_id

snapshot.name: club_entitlements
snapshot.sql: SELECT c.name AS club, e.effective_access_ends_at, e.refreshed_at, e.updated_at, e.revision::text AS revision, (SELECT t.payment_reference FROM club_license_terms t WHERE t.id = e.effective_term_id) AS effective_term_reference, e.effective_term_id IS NULL AS no_effective_term, (SELECT x.expired_at FROM club_expiry_cycles x WHERE x.id = e.current_expiry_cycle_id) AS cycle_expired_at, e.current_expiry_cycle_id IS NOT NULL AS has_cycle FROM club_entitlements e JOIN clubs c ON c.id = e.club_id ORDER BY c.name

snapshot.name: club_expiry_cycles
snapshot.sql: SELECT c.name AS club, x.expired_at, x.delete_public_pages_after, x.cancelled_at, (SELECT t.payment_reference FROM club_license_terms t WHERE t.id = x.cancellation_term_id) AS cancellation_term_reference, x.state::text AS state, x.created_at, x.updated_at, x.revision::text AS revision FROM club_expiry_cycles x JOIN clubs c ON c.id = x.club_id ORDER BY c.name, x.expired_at

snapshot.name: session_publications
snapshot.sql: SELECT p.public_key, p.state::text AS state, p.revision::text AS revision, p.updated_at, (SELECT x.expired_at FROM club_expiry_cycles x WHERE x.id = p.expiry_cycle_id) AS retained_under_cycle_expired_at, p.expiry_cycle_id IS NOT NULL AS retained FROM session_publications p ORDER BY p.public_key

snapshot.name: clubs
snapshot.sql: SELECT name, license_pricing::text AS license_pricing, license_monthly_minor, license_yearly_minor, currency, revision::text AS revision, updated_at FROM clubs ORDER BY name

snapshot.name: admin_audit_events
snapshot.sql: SELECT a.id, a.actor_admin_id, a.action, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.source_command_id, a.occurred_at, a.metadata - 'termId' AS metadata, (SELECT t.payment_reference FROM club_license_terms t WHERE t.id::text = a.metadata ->> 'termId') AS term_reference FROM admin_audit_events a ORDER BY a.action, a.target_type, a.source_command_id NULLS FIRST, a.occurred_at, a.metadata::text, a.target_id

snapshot.name: player_notifications
snapshot.sql: SELECT id FROM player_notifications ORDER BY id
